mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Powerful software shouldn't cost the planet. We consult on and build technology infrastructure for organizations that want to modernize it and reduce its energy consumption at the same time.

vision.title: Our Approach
vision.text: We have 15+ years in software architecture, cloud systems, and digital transformation, and the work ranges from modernizing legacy systems to building new ones. That includes OCPP protocol implementation for EV charging, AWS infrastructure optimization, embedded systems, and system integration.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Consulting and development work to modernize your technology infrastructure

consulting.title: Software Consulting
consulting.description: 15+ years of software architecture, technology selection, and review work. We specialize in OCPP 1.6, EV charging systems, AWS, and system integration.

transformation.title: Digital Transformation
transformation.description: We modernize enterprise systems: AWS cloud migration, process automation, and CMMI-compliant development practices.

development.title: Custom Development
development.description: Backend systems, RESTful APIs, and cross-platform software in Python and C++20. Protocol development and system integration are where we spend most of our time.

zekky.name: Zekky
zekky.tagline: Find the right answer before the clock does
zekky.description: Zekky is a math and reflex game where you tap the right answer before the clock runs out. It plays free in the browser and shows no ads.

card.excerpt: Tap the right answer while the clock runs. Rounds are ten questions of math and number patterns, and your level rises as you play. No ads, and it plays free in your browser.

portfonio.name: Portfonio
portfonio.tagline: Portfolio tracking for Turkish mutual funds
portfonio.intro: Portfonio is a Django application for managing Turkish mutual fund portfolios. It pulls TEFAS data daily, tracks what you hold, and shows how each fund has performed.
portfonio.highlight: 2,316+ Turkish mutual funds, priced daily from TEFAS

card.excerpt: Track and analyze Turkish investment funds in one place. Prices refresh daily from TEFAS. Free to start, no credit card required.

items.title: Multi-user portfolios:
items.description: Each user's portfolio is isolated behind authentication

items.title: Daily TEFAS integration:
items.description: Prices for 2,316+ Turkish mutual funds refresh every day

items.title: Transaction tracking:
items.description: Buy and sell entries, with holdings calculated from them

items.title: Fund tagging:
items.description: Tag groups for organizing and filtering funds

items.title: Weekend and holiday prices:
items.description: Falls back to the last trading day so valuations stay correct

items.title: Performance charts:
items.description: Interactive charts and metrics for the whole portfolio

architecture.title: Engineering practices
features: Automated test suite runs in CI on every change
N+1 queries eliminated, cutting database calls by 83%
Pre-commit hooks with Ruff linting and Black formatting
Celery runs the daily update job in the background

simit.name: SimItNow
simit.tagline: Test EV charging systems without the hardware

card.excerpt: Test your EV charging systems without hardware. Simulate charge points against a CSMS, or run a hosted CSMS for your chargers to connect to. Speaks OCPP 1.6 and 2.0.1 either way, and runs load tests. Free plan available.

ddogreen.name: DDOGreen
ddogreen.tagline: Power management that runs in the background

card.excerpt: Watches how busy your machine is and switches power modes automatically. Install it and it runs in the background with no setup.
